theorem: Under the C023 NAND3+NEQ embedding and the canonical affine parameterization x_i=lambda_i, c_i=1 XOR lambda_i, exact coordinate translation of the Horn NAND3 clauses is syntactically identical to the source 3-CNF.
blocked_shortcut: Affine-coordinate substitution alone simplifies unrestricted Horn-affine composition.
claim_boundary: This blocks only coordinate substitution without an independently proved tractable structural certificate. It does not rule out richer semantic compression and does not prove P!=NP.
